entries.zh: 萬萬歲：祝颂「愿大人长活千岁」；万岁欢呼（汉字栏作「萬乙歲」，「乙」当系重文符号或形讹）。
entries.en: 'Long live Your Grace (V.mg. = Vuestra Magestad/merced) a thousand years'; the longevity acclamation 'ten thousand, ten thousand years'.
entries.notes: 词头缩写 V.mg. 之展开依赖推断（Vuestra merced／Magestad 两可）；官话栏三音节对音证实汉字实读「萬萬歲」，「乙」为书写变体。

entries.zh: 壽數：寿命、命数；西语为祝寿套语「愿你活千年、长享遐龄」。
entries.en: lifespan, allotted length of days; Spanish blessing 'may you live a thousand years and see long ages (largas edades)'.

entries.zh: 納福：享福、纳受福气、安享清福。
entries.en: to receive and enjoy blessings; to live in ease and comfort.
entries.notes: 闽南栏第二声调记号污损（T99），西语词头连写难辨（「suce deretos」疑为 goce derechos 类祝语）；汉字「納福」清楚，释义以汉字与西语祝语语境为主。

entries.zh: 夫妻保老：愿夫妻相守到老、白头偕老；西语祝辞「愿夫妻同活千年」。
entries.en: blessing that husband and wife keep each other into old age; 'may husband and wife live a thousand years'.

entries.zh: 在：居住、逗留；身处某地（西语 estar, morar）。
entries.en: to be at/in a place, to reside, to dwell.
to live, to have life, be alive.

entries.zh: 生：活着、生存；出生（闽南音写后半「dse · nacir idz」污损难辨）。
entries.en: to live, be alive; to be born (cf. Spanish nacer); remainder of the phonetic column smudged.
entries.notes: 音写后半难辨且第二声调记号污损（T99）；「nacir」疑为音写西语 nacer（出生），汉字「生」本身清楚。

entries.zh: 陽（陽間）：阳世、人间，与阴间相对；活在人世。
entries.en: the world of the living (yang realm), as opposed to the netherworld; to be alive in this world.

entries.zh: 立：住、居住、安家立身（此处「立」取安住立户之义，非站立）。
entries.en: to live in a house, to dwell, take up residence ('li' in the sense of settling one's dwelling).

entries.zh: 立所在：居住在一处、定居某地（所在＝地方、处所）。
entries.en: to live in a place or village, reside in a locality.

entries.zh: 濫做：胡乱做事、行事无章法；生活散漫紊乱。
entries.en: to live disorderly, act recklessly and without order.

entries.zh: 行：品行、为人行事；立身处世端正（西语「在道德上善度生活、行走」）。
entries.en: to conduct oneself morally well; conduct, manner of walking (of life).

entries.zh: 泰：安泰、平安顺遂；太平自在（音写栏内夹注西语「tener paz」＝有平安）。
entries.en: ease, peace, tranquility; to live in well-being ('tener paz', to have peace).
entries.notes: 音写栏内直接夹有西语小注 tener paz，印证「泰＝平安」义，汉西对应明确。

entries.zh: 危（危難）：危难、度日不安；生活无平安。
entries.en: danger, peril, distress; to live without peace.

entries.zh: 命帶煞：命中带凶煞；旧谓夫妻命格相克、纠缠多灾（西语大意「夫妻二人相缠而活」）。
entries.en: one's destiny carries a baleful star; fatalistic notion of clashing, entangled fates — especially between wife and husband.

entries.zh: 立平善：平安和善地度日；安然生活。
entries.en: to live in peace, peaceably and in goodness.

entries.zh: 行平善：行事平和良善、与人无争地生活。
entries.en: to conduct oneself peaceably and well, live in peace.

entries.zh: 生死：生与死；生而向死、在死亡威胁中度日（西语「活着却正在死去」）。
entries.en: life and death; to live in a dying state, at death's door ('living dying').
entries.notes: 首声调记号污损（T99）；汉字「生死」清楚且与西语 Vivir muriendo 相合，义为生与死、濒死苟活。

entries.zh: 守己（汉字栏作「守已」）：守己安分、保身自持；谨慎处世。
entries.en: to preserve oneself, keep to one's own; prudent self-restraint, conservatively guarded living.
entries.notes: 首声调记号污损（T99）；「守已」当读「守己」，合西语 conservadamente（守成自保）之义。
